summary: PongTrace processes videos and movement data primarily on your device. No account, developer server, ads, analytics or tracking.

ui.flowTitle: Built around on-device processing and your control

highlights.label: Commercial tracking
highlights.value: No ads · No analytics · No tracking

flow.title: You choose the input
flow.body: Camera frames, recordings and selected media are processed only when you actively use the relevant feature.

flow.title: Processing stays on device
flow.body: Pose detection, movement metrics, rally montages and movement comparison run locally on your iPhone.

flow.title: You choose when data leaves
flow.body: Content leaves PongTrace only when you actively save, export, share or send email.

sections.title: Current privacy practices
sections.body: The current version requires no account, uses no developer-operated server and contains no advertising, analytics or tracking. PongTrace does not upload your videos, pose data or app activity.

sections.title: Operator and scope of control
sections.body: PongTrace is operated by an independent individual developer. Videos, pose results, training projects and settings stored only on your device are not received by or accessible to the developer. The developer directly receives an email address and message content only when you choose to send feedback, and uses them to handle your request.

sections.title: Information processed
sections.body: With your permission or selection, PongTrace processes camera frames, recorded or imported videos, body-pose keypoints, movement metrics, rally segments, action-comparison results, exported clips and app settings. This information is used only to provide recording, analysis, rally compilation, action comparison, playback, export and preference features. It is not used to identify or verify you.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
sections.body: Core features process media on your device in response to your actions to provide the functions you choose to use. If you send feedback, the developer processes the email address and message only as needed to respond, provide support, protect legitimate interests or meet legal obligations. Depending on the circumstances, the legal basis may be fulfilling your request, the developer’s legitimate interests, a legal obligation or your consent.

sections.title: On-device processing
sections.body: Pose recognition, movement-metric calculation, rally compilation analysis and action comparison run on your device. PongTrace has no feature that sends videos, pose keypoints or movement metrics to a developer server, advertising service or analytics service.

sections.title: Permissions and selected media
sections.body: PongTrace requests camera access only for live recognition and recording. When you import a video through an Apple system picker, you decide which content to select. Add-only Photos access is requested only when you save a result to Photos. You can change these permissions at any time in iOS Settings.

sections.title: Local storage, retention and deletion
sections.body: Training recordings, pose samples, action-comparison projects, exported clips and preferences are stored in the app sandbox until you delete them with available in-app controls or delete the app. Temporary working files may be created while media is processed. Copies saved to Photos, Files or another destination must be deleted separately at that destination.

sections.title: Sharing and external services
sections.body: Content leaves PongTrace only when you actively save to Photos or Files, export, use the system share sheet or send email. The destination app or service processes information under its own policy; an email provider may process information you choose to send in the regions where it operates. PongTrace does not upload local device content or initiate cross-border transfers of that content.

sections.title: Data security
sections.body: PongTrace limits processing through on-device operation, the iOS app sandbox, Apple system permission controls and data minimization. No storage or transmission method can guarantee absolute security. Protect your device passcode, backups and copies exported outside the app.

sections.title: Advertising, analytics and tracking
sections.body: The current version contains no advertising, analytics or tracking features and does not use personal information for advertising or tracking. If these practices change, PongTrace will update this policy and its App Store privacy disclosures before the new processing begins and will obtain consent where required by law.

sections.title: Children’s privacy
sections.body: PongTrace is a general-purpose sports tool and is not designed to actively collect personal information from children. The current version has no account, advertising, tracking or online content-collection flow. Where required by law, children should use the app with a parent or guardian involved.

sections.title: Privacy choices and legal rights
sections.body: You can refuse or withdraw permissions in iOS Settings, delete content using in-app controls or delete the app to remove its sandbox data. Because the developer does not receive on-device data, you manage that data directly on the device. For information you voluntarily provide in feedback and the developer receives directly, use Settings > Contact & Feedback in the app to make any access, correction, deletion, restriction or other request available under applicable law. Reasonable identity verification may be required.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated when features, legal requirements or data practices change. A revision will show a new policy version and effective date. Material changes will be communicated through the app, release notes or this page as appropriate.

websiteHosting.title: Hosting of this privacy page
websiteHosting.body: This page is delivered through GitHub Pages. GitHub may process your IP address and necessary technical logs to deliver and secure the site and prevent abuse. GitHub is responsible for that processing under its own policy; it is separate from PongTrace’s on-device processing. This page uses no developer-installed analytics, advertising or trackers.
